caseData.headline: Likely: bad loans are being reported as good ones

findings.plain: bad loans are being reported as good ones
the borrower is connected to undisclosed shell companies

signals.explanation: Servicer-system pull: 4 of 60 sampled 'eligible' loans are actually 60+ days late or no longer active
Loans reported current but with no payment for two months were pulled from the servicer system: 4 of 4 are actually 60+ days late or no longer active
5 loans' credit scores at origination were rewritten after the fact, from below the 600 eligibility line to above it
'Meridian Logistics LLC' looks like a shell: same address as borrower, formed 9 months ago, no LEI / not in GLEIF
Undisclosed related company 'Meridian Logistics LLC' shares the borrower's officer and address
4.3% of loans reported current had no payment arrive (14 of 326)

steps.title: Expand the source-system sample on the affected pool
steps.draft:
INTERNAL ACTION MEMO — Expand the source-system sample on the affected pool
Case: B0003 · Finding: bad loans are being reported as good ones (medium confidence)
Action: Increase the servicer-system sample to at least 200 loans and compare status field by field.

  - Servicer-system pull: 4 of 60 sampled 'eligible' loans are actually 60+ days late or no longer active [ref S2-B0003-SOURCE_MISMATCH-fbc3b6bb]
  - 4.3% of loans reported current had no payment arrive (14 of 326) [ref S2-B0003-CURRENT_WITHOUT_PAYMENT-1e944760]
